name: WildsBuilder
taglineEs: Set builder independiente y rápido para MH Wilds: armas tú las equipas, las skills y decoraciones las resuelve la herramienta, y compartes el set con un link — sin cuenta, todo guardado en tu browser
taglineEn: Fast independent set builder for MH Wilds: you pick the weapon, it solves skills and decorations, and you share the set with a link — no account, everything stored in your browser
